description: Two bearded men in dark and tan robes work at a large wooden loom, weaving a carpet with a tree of life, animals, a stream and floral borders. The workshop is dim, lit by candles and oil lamps, with a dyeing vat and other workers in the background. The wooden loom and lamps suggest a pre-modern workshop. No letters or numbers are visible, only a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner; the painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border or wall, and nothing is violent or nude.
reason: Shows men weaving a carpet at a loom in a candlelit workshop, but the card is the Blue Mosque in Istanbul.
